entries.name: MCP authorization (OAuth 2.1, protected resource metadata)
entries.tracked: 2025-11-25; 2026-07-28 adds RFC 9207 iss validation and prefers Client ID Metadata Documents over Dynamic Client Registration
entries.why: Remote MCP servers must not be open; the 401 challenge and resource metadata let any client find the authorization server.

tests.name: discovery: api catalog and protected resource

entries.gap: The tenant kit (seed/worker) still validates a static bearer token in a secret binding; its AuthPort takes the same OAuth adapter as ultrastable.io (see mcp-auth-site) and nothing else changes.

sources.title: Cloudflare: Piecing together the Agent puzzle (MCP, authn/authz, Durable Objects)

entries.name: MCP authorization on ultrastable.io (OAuth 2.1 server: PKCE, Client ID Metadata Documents, dynamic registration)
entries.tracked: 2025-11-25; 2026-07-28 prefers Client ID Metadata Documents over Dynamic Client Registration, requires RFC 9207 iss
entries.why: A person never pastes a token: any MCP client finds the authorization server from the 401 challenge (RFC 9728, RFC 8414), identifies itself by metadata URL or registration, and the owner approves once in the browser.

entries.name: MCP registry (server.json publication)
entries.tracked: registry preview; server.json published from the verified namespace (STD-1) and verified under STD-14 of the standards wave
entries.why: Public discoverability of the server by directory-based clients.

entries.name: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol
entries.why: Agent-to-agent delegation across vendors; the card lets another agent find this organisation and its skills.
entries.gap: Card is published and honest (interface is MCP). The A2A task interface (send message, tasks) is not served yet; card field names must be re-checked against the v1.0.1 schema when it is added.
